title: 1 Pound
description: The 1 pound coin is a secure, twelve-sided, bimetallic coin introduced in 2017. It’s a key part of UK currency.

messages.text: When was the current 1 pound coin introduced?
What metals are used in it?
What was the old pound coin like?
It was round and less secure.
Is the old pound still valid?
What’s on the back of the coin?
A design representing the UK’s nations.
Yes, it works in most machines.
